summary.zh: 横向对比框架优劣与迁移成本再决定
summary.en: Score frameworks side by side before you commit

description.zh: 在定下技术方案前做横向比较：功能匹配、生态活跃度、总体拥有成本和迁移风险，逐项打分。适合纠结 X 还是 Y、考虑换栈，或判断一次迁移是否值得时使用。
description.en: Compares frameworks and stacks before you commit: feature fit, ecosystem health, total cost of ownership and migration risk, scored side by side. Use it for X vs Y calls or weighing a migration.
